title: Give the Craft Hands
hints: The well-wisher only talks right now — it never touches blessing-count.txt. Its action needs a real Bash step: read the number, add one, write it back.

A skill has full tool access by default. Add allowed-tools: Bash to the frontmatter to explicitly scope it down to just what it needs — the point isn't that it needs granting, it's that it should be limited on purpose.
Open a session here and actually invoke well-wisher once you've edited it, so blessing-count.txt really changes.
